messages:
deploy-bot: NOTICE: canary v4.2.0 error-rate +3.5% on route embeddings-usw. Autorevert in 3m unless operator intervention. details: https://telemetry/4.2.0?range=5m
zoe: I see the spike, looks isolated to embeddings-usw-2. Can we suppress auto while we triage?
raj: Oncall here. If it's single shard, prefer targeted traffic pin back to v4.1.9 for embeddings route instead of full revert. Minimizes churn.
devin: Agree. Quick triage: check schema mismatch logs from the tokenizer service and model signature. Also check envoy 503s on that shard.
paula: Heads-up to CS: small number of inference failures reported, prepping customer alert in case we need to widen rollback. @cs-leads
ops-bot: Autorevert countdown: 180s. Next alert at 120s.
zoe: Plan: 1) suppress autorevert timer 2) pin embeddings route in canary to v4.1.9 3) drain v4.2.0 on embeddings-usw-2 4) monitor errors & tail logs 5) file follow-up. Who can run route-pin?
raj: I can run the route pin: ```bash
rls route-pin --env canary --route embeddings-usw --to v4.1.9 --reason "spike on shard"
```
devin: Also run a quick grep on tokenizer logs: ```bash
kubectl logs tokenizer-xyz -n prod | grep -i "signature mismatch" -n | tail -n 50
```
ops-bot: Operator override request from raj accepted. Suppressing autorevert for 20m.
ops-bot: Executing: rls route-pin --env canary --route embeddings-usw --to v4.1.9
ops-bot: SUCCESS: route embeddings-usw pinned to v4.1.9. Traffic rebalanced.
zoe: Watching error-rate drop. p95 latency stable. Good call on targeted pin.
paula: Sent short CS note: "We rerouted a subset of canary traffic to a previous version due to elevated errors on one shard. We're monitoring and will update in 15m."
devin: Found tokenizer warnings around UTF8 decode for a small client id set. Logging the example payloads to ticket RL-4321.
raj: I'll keep the pin for now and follow up with a rollback postmortem. If errors stay low for 15m, we can unpin and proceed with a cautious rollout.
zoe: Thanks all — nice quick coordination. :raised_hands:
